image.alt: 深蓝产品主屏与三组微缩工作站组成的软件展陈场景

brief.subject: One dominant deep navy software dashboard inside a clear glass outer panel; three slim miniature laptop stations and two tiny white scale figures on a thin stepped square base.
brief.action: The two operators inspect the shared software workspace from their small laptops, while the large screen brings the related application areas together.
brief.structure: The main screen is the common product focus; the subordinate workstations sit on connected terraces around its base, expressing a single shared work environment rather than a timed process.
brief.details: Three slender rear architectural volumes, four small glass interface cards, fine gold trim, a few small white planters, and two translucent muted-teal blocks; leave the front stair and glass perimeter complete.
brief.composition: 16:9 landscape, moderate near-isometric camera; central screen about half the image width, laptops one fifth of its width; preserve clear off-white margins, especially below the frontmost base corner.

visual.rationale: 以大幅产品展陈引入，封面文字负责价值与范围，图中不再重复说明标签。

brief.subject: A complete miniature workflow built from three distinct workstations: a laptop intake desk, a central validation gate, and a records archive, all on one warm white platform.
brief.action: Small teal document tiles move from the intake laptop through the validation gate into organized archival stacks.
brief.structure: A physical muted teal channel links the three stations in sequence; the central gate separates unverified incoming documents from verified archive tiles.
brief.details: Use a thin navy laptop, clear architectural glass cards, restrained champagne metal edges, five visible document tiles and a small archival tray. Preserve the established refined device scale.
brief.composition: 16:9 landscape, balanced three-quarter view. Show the complete platform and document route with modest safety margins, no large unused backdrop.

brief.subject: A refined miniature task workbench with a single wide navy application display, a slender laptop and three shallow record trays showing incoming, active and archived work.
brief.action: A miniature operator reviews active tasks while completed record tiles are collected in the final archive tray.
brief.structure: The three trays sit in a left-to-right sequence under the application display, visually linking an incoming task to its active workspace and then to its saved result.
brief.details: Include slim glass screen edges, delicate activity rows and restrained chart lines, softly beveled warm white trays, muted teal tiles, and one small champagne status accent.
brief.composition: 16:9 balanced three-quarter composition, equal visual scale to the companion workflow scene. Keep the display, trays and platform complete with small safe margins.

brief.subject: An integrated product platform miniature with one central navy dashboard and three lower workstations arranged around its shared base, illustrating distinct product capabilities.
brief.action: Miniature operators inspect incoming tasks and completed records at the workstations around the main display.

brief.details: Keep the navy software screen crisp, devices thin, figures very small, three work desks visibly separate, transparent perimeter glass and muted teal record cards with sparse gold trim.

brief.subject: A close view of a collaborative processing area containing one document preparation station, a validation gate and a result review desk on an elongated platform.
brief.action: An operator passes a prepared record through the gate while another checks the completed stack at the review desk.
brief.structure: A low shared connector joins the preparation station to the gate and then the review desk; piles before and after the gate make the handoff visible.
brief.details: Use clear glass review cards, two thin navy laptops, teal record stacks at different stages, a small white lamp and precisely bevelled platform edges with subtle champagne metal.

image.alt: 两组微缩团队把软件模块接入同一完整产品平台

brief.subject: A miniature software delivery review station with one navy display, three architectural service modules, a records tray and two small operators checking the assembled solution.
brief.action: The operators compare the delivered modules with a neat set of verification records at the review desk.
brief.structure: Three separate service blocks dock into matching bays on a common base. A clear glass divider distinguishes the delivered assembly from the incoming records used to verify it.
brief.details: Use a thin high-resolution navy display, a small laptop, five muted teal record tiles in a tray, precise warm white platform bevels and very restrained champagne metallic trims.
brief.composition: 4:3 close three-quarter view, the entire delivery station fills the frame with modest margins. Keep all service blocks and the review records clearly visible.

brief.subject: Two small white scale figures at a compact navy-and-white product platform, with two thin software modules and a modest glass display wall behind them.
brief.action: One figure seats a final teal-edged module into the shared platform while the other checks the connection at a slim nearby laptop.
brief.structure: Two modules join one continuous thin base; the fitted joint makes the completed product assembly visible without adding a new workflow or hierarchy.
brief.details: Fine glass perimeter, small navy interface panels, a single gold connector and one tiny planter; clear scale separation between the platform, operators and laptop.
brief.composition: 4:3, low balanced three-quarter view, complete miniature assembly and soft shadow inside generous margins for use beside the closing copy.
